description.value: Blackbird Bakery has been a Pemberton institution since 2009, founded by French pastry chef Raven Burns, who trained under Michelin 3-Star chef Thierry Busset before settling in the mountains. The women-run bakery bakes everything from scratch daily using organic, locally sourced dairy, meat, and produce from Pemberton Valley farms, with coffee roasted in-valley. Located in the village train centre with both indoor and outdoor seating, it offers fresh bread, croissants, sandwiches, and savoury pies—solid provisions for a touring cyclist passing through the Sea-to-Sky corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and corroborates the OSM address, confirms the phone number (absent from OSM), and provides rich detail about the bakery's offerings. No bike parking or water refill is mentioned anywhere in the OSM tags or website content. Hot food is confirmed via explicit menu items (breakfast sandwiches, grilled sandwiches, meat pies, sausage rolls); bread products (sourdough, baguette, potato loaf) support a 'basic groceries' value for touring cyclists resupplying on route.
concerns: Phone number 604.894.6226 found on website but absent from OSM tags — OSM record should be updated.
Minor postcode discrepancy: FAQ page lists V0N 2L0 while all other pages and OSM use V0N 2L1; V0N 2L1 treated as correct.
Bike parking not mentioned anywhere; this is a required criterion for WWC accreditation and should be field-verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An established, actively operating artisan bakery-café in the heart of Pemberton with quality hot food and fresh bread — a clear and practical stop for touring cyclists on the Sea-to-Sky corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Outdoor seating confirmed via both OSM (outdoor_seating=yes) and website. Gluten-friendly options noted on website (brownie, banana bread) but bakery explicitly warns celiacs it is not suitable due to open-concept flour-in-the-air kitchen.

provenance.category_correction_reason: shop=bakery is the source tag; this is a full-service café-bakery rather than a traditional grocery. 'Café' or 'Food & Drink' may be a better directory category, but bread and baked provisions sold here do serve a resupply function for cyclists.
